query: Which privacy-preserving anonymization and consent practices (salted hashing, client-side redaction, differential privacy thresholds) preserve analytic utility while meeting IRB and industrial NDA constraints?

response.query: Which privacy-preserving anonymization and consent practices (salted hashing, client-side redaction, differential privacy thresholds) preserve analytic utility while meeting IRB and industrial NDA constraints?
response.answer: Salted hashing, client-side redaction, and differential privacy thresholds preserve analytic utility while meeting IRB and industrial NDA constraints. These methods protect privacy without compromising data usability.
